subject: Brigitte Macron appearing to push Emmanuel Macron's face as their plane door opened in Hanoi
called_fake_by: The Élysée Palace (the president's office), according to French media
claim: The footage was shot by the Associated Press on May 25. As it spread, French media reported that Macron's office first dismissed it as AI-generated.
finding: The footage was real. The Élysée confirmed it. Macron said the video clips being discussed were all real and described the moment as joking with his wife. That is his account; the camera didn't show her face.
outcome: According to French media, the office went from suggesting AI to confirming the footage within about a day. An unnamed source close to Macron blamed pro-Russian accounts for the negative commentary. Macron himself criticized how the videos were being interpreted online.

sources.title: A video of the French president's wife shoving him went viral. Here's why it matters
Emmanuel Macron's wife Brigitte Macron appears to shove his face upon arrival in Hanoi
